visible_text: WIN AND LOSE CONDITIONS: MANAGING RESOURCES
During this game all players manage the six ROAD TRIP RESOURCES.
The LOSE CONDITION is one RESOURCE reaching ZERO. If this happens, a GAME OVER will trigger.
The WIN CONDITION is reaching a DESTINATION, which is accomplished by hoarding one RESOURCE enough, till you meet the DESTINATION REQUIREMENT (which can always be consulted).

visible_text: There's a DESTINATION GUIDE you can always consult during the game by pressing
In there, you can check how close you are to reaching each DESTINATION.

visible_text: In this game, all players share the same RESOURCES. In MULTIPLAYER mode, you must co-operate and go in the same direction if you want to reach a DESTINATION together!
The LOSE and WIN CONDITIONS are reached as a group. If someone triggers a GAME OVER, it's GAME OVER for EVERYONE. If someone does the final push into a DESTINATION, EVERYONE gets there.
There are INDIVIDUAL aspects of the game; but we'll discuss them in other chapters.
You run out of money and have to end the road trip early.

visible_text: YOUR RESOURCES ARE MANAGED IN A NUMBER OF WAYS:
(this is the main way of managing RESOURCES)

visible_text: The EVENTS make up the main content of the GAME. In most of the EVENTS you must guess the RESOURCES associated with OPTIONS.
How do you properly guess the ASSOCIATED RESOURCES?
Here's a guide on how to properly guess a RESOURCE LOSS or RESOURCE GAIN out of an EVENT OPTION:
Anything that would usually mean making money: selling something, doing a job, robbing someone, etc.

Spending or investing money. It can be buying something, renting something, hiring someone, etc. Sometimes this might be inferred by MONEY-related keywords. The OPTION might say nothing about BUYING something, but mention using an EXPENSIVE ITEM. That'd be a clue that OPTION is going to make you LOSE MONEY.
4.image_description: The page has a black background with faded resource-face icons. On the right is a green panel with money gain and money loss examples.

visible_text: You might GAIN MAGIC by acquiring a magic item or making a magic pact. You could get the blessing of a deity and receive part of their magic power.

Some MAGIC-related actions might be tricky: performing a sacrifice to receive magic power implies a GAIN of MAGIC, while a sacrifice that requires magic implies a LOSS of it. Because of this duality, it helps trying to infer the other ASSOCIATED RESOURCE or pay attention to the KNOWN RESOURCE if there is one.
Keep in mind MAGIC is also the fuel for your car. That means that, if you go to a gas station, you can probably gain some MAGIC.
Performing any magic action might cost you MAGIC. Spells, summonings, curses, illusions... even a bit of sleight of hand could mean MAGIC LOSS.
Also, since MAGIC is the fuel you use, going hard on your car might mean LOSING some MAGIC.
5.image_description: The page has a black background with faded resource-face icons. A large pink panel explains magic gain on the left and magic loss on the right.

visible_text: STAMINA is energy for your body. You can get your STAMINA up by feeding yourself, drinking, or resting. Think about how you'd get your energy up normally!
Keep in mind drinking lots of alcohol isn't usually a way of getting hydrated, though!

Anything that'd make you physically exhausted, from running a lot to having lots of sex. Alcohol and drugs can get tricky: they might affect either your STAMINA or your MIND. It's all about the wording.
Always remember that some drugs dehydrate you. If you choose to do them recreationally, at least do them responsibly, and always carry a water bottle with you.

Also, you can get your STAMINA down if you use your food in ways other than eating. So if you were to throw a pie at someone, that could get your STAMINA down, since you'd be wasting a resource you had with yourself for STAMINA reasons.
6.image_description: The page has a black background with faded resource-face icons. An orange panel explains stamina gain on the left and stamina loss on the right.

visible_text: You can GAIN MIND by learning new things. Think of MIND as intelligence. But also think of MIND as "peace of mind". While STAMINA GAIN is resting your body, MIND GAIN is relaxing your brain. Find enlightenment; find bliss.
Make your mind calmer; make your mind stronger.

You'll lose MIND if you overtax your brain. Stress, anxiety, panic, confusion... all that might translate into MIND LOSS. Trying to understand stuff beyond mortal comprehension will make you lose MIND. Getting into a very long intellectual debate might not mean gaining MIND out of what you learn, but losing MIND out of using your brain a bit too much.
Be fun, be epic. Laugh out loud; practice thrill-inducing sports; do epic shit; go to town... all that might convert into HYPE GAIN.
Avoid fun and epic, and you will encounter HYPE LOSS. Choose OPTIONS that feel a bit too mundane; do boring stuff; mingle with dull or annoying people.
7.image_description: The page has a black background with faded resource-face icons. A purple panel on the left explains mind gain and mind loss. A blue panel on the right explains hype gain and hype loss.

visible_text: SOUL is easy: do good deeds and you'll GAIN SOUL. Help others; be good to society; practice empathy; avoid confrontation; etc.
Again, SOUL is easy: be your worst self and you'll LOSE SOUL. Commit crimes; fuck people over; take advantage of others; tell (perjudicial) lies; cheat; and so on.
TIPS AND NOTES ON GUESSING RESOURCES
Always check if there's a KNOWN RESOURCE (see EXCHANGE EVENTS). It doesn't matter if an OPTION seems to mean a RESOURCE LOSS or GAIN; if there's a KNOWN RESOURCE, that always takes precedent.

Lots of times it helps a lot to search for "KEY WORDS". Maybe there's an option you're not sure about... but you spot the word "PREMIUM" or "EXPENSIVE". That could very well be a KEY WORD that tells you the OPTION is somehow ASSOCIATED with MONEY.
8.image_description: The page has a black background with faded resource-face icons. A yellow panel on the left explains soul gain and soul loss. Two speech bubbles on the right contain tips and notes on guessing resources.

visible_text: The main goal of the game is to reach one of SIX DESTINATIONS. As mentioned in other chapters, you can check the DESTINATIONS at any time by looking at the DESTINATION GUIDE.
You get to a DESTINATION by hoarding a specific amount of a RESOURCE (the amount can be consulted at the DESTINATION GUIDE). There's ONE DESTINATION per RESOURCE.
It's important to note that the requirement is only checked after a REST STOP. If you hit the requirement but then you go below it before leaving a REST STOP, you won't reach a DESTINATION.
9.image_description: The page has a green background. Two screenshots on the lower left show the destination guide and a destination requirement panel. A large pink note panel on the right explains that destination requirements are checked after a rest stop.

visible_text: Every DESTINATION has THREE LAYERS. Each LAYER adds extra special stuff to the DESTINATIONS.
The most basic LAYER is the one that, as mentioned before, is achieved by reaching a certain amount of a RESOURCE.

There's a second LAYER that is achieved by bonding with a specific HITCHHIKER. Each DESTINATION requires its own HITCHHIKER. The DESTINATION GUIDE includes clues on which each HITCHHIKER corresponds to each DESTINATION. Bonding means successfully having a DEEP CONVERSATION with them.

The third LAYER is achieved by successfully completing a PLOTLINE. Each DESTINATION has its own PLOTLINE. When you have enough of a RESOURCE, you'll be asked if you want to trigger the PLOTLINE for the DESTINATION tied to that RESOURCE.
10.image_description: A large layered illustration on the left is marked with the numbers 1, 2, and 3. On the right, three numbered boxes explain the three destination layers.

visible_text: LAME LOSER, OK and MVP endings are handled depending on your score. What is your SCORE? It is measured differently depending on the mode you're playing:

NOTE: The DATE ENDING overrides OK and MVP endings since the player has chosen by themselves that they want to get that ending (when they say they want to be more than friends with the character they bonded with). But the LAME LOSER ending overrides the DATE ENDING because there's no dates for lame losers.

Players collect a currency called "PRANK DOLLARZ". Players are ranked from most PRANK DOLLARZ to least PRANK DOLLARZ. The highest ranking player gets the MVP ending while the lowest ranking player gets the LAME LOSER ending. The other players (if any) get OK endings.

Players are ranked based on how much of the RESOURCE tied to the DESTINATION reached they gained during the trip. The highest ranking player gets the MVP ending while the lowest ranking player gets the LAME LOSER ending. The other players (if any) get OK endings.
No individual endings in this mode, a standard OK ending will trigger for the whole team.
Players earn PRANK DOLLARZ and they get an individual ending based on how many PRANK DOLLARZ they earned. There are thresholds that must be surpassed to get a better ending.
Good individual endings are earned by not having any low RESOURCE. There are thresholds to decide this: if a RESOURCE is lower than a certain threshold, the player gets a worse individual ending.

The DATE ENDING is always the same: you can achieve this ending by successfully having a DEEP CONVERSATION in the REST STOP with a character and then confirming that you are more than friends with them.

visible_text: THIS GAME HAS SEVERAL DIFFERENT TYPES OF EVENTS.
The most common ones by far are known as "EXCHANGE EVENTS",
which are in itself a different type of event that only happens during the "REST STOP".
And finally, there are some more rare types of events we will list and check in the end.

visible_text: "Exchange Events" are the most common type of events in this game.
Exchange events are zero-sum events where a RESOURCE is always gained and another RESOURCE is always lost in the same amount.
What do you want to do?
If the icon shows a "?", there's no KNOWN RESOURCE; you must guess both gain and loss.

When choosing an ACTION (that will trigger an EXCHANGE EVENT), the icon next to the event icon could show one of the SIX RESOURCES in a POSITIVE or NEGATIVE position. This icon is called "KNOWN RESOURCE", and it tells you which specific RESOURCE will be gained or lost for sure.

For instance, maybe an ACTION consists of buying something at a shop. A "NEGATIVE MONEY" icon is shown, meaning that the player will always lose MONEY when buying in the shop. NEGATIVE MONEY is the KNOWN RESOURCE.
Exchange events provide 2 or 3 options for the player to choose from. Each option is tied to a RESOURCE GAIN, a RESOURCE LOSS, or BOTH. The goal is to choose a beneficial option for the players.

A KNOWN RESOURCE is incredibly useful when playing strategically. Maybe it says you will always GAIN a RESOURCE you're farming. Or maybe it ensures you will LOSE a RESOURCE you have no problem losing (helping you avoid the risk of losing a RESOURCE that could make you lose the game).

The goal in "EXCHANGE EVENTS" is guessing the ASSOCIATED RESOURCES successfully, and then choosing options to manage your RESOURCES in order not to reach zero on a RESOURCE, while also hoarding enough of a RESOURCE to reach a DESTINATION. Alternatively, just choose whatever the heart wants, focus on having fun, and hope for the best!

visible_text: QUANTITIES EVENTS are the second most common type of event. They always present three OPTIONS and each of them affect your RESOURCES to varying degrees:

Keep in mind that, other than that, it's still similar to an EXCHANGE EVENT in which your goal is to guess which RESOURCES are associated with each option. We've created these EVENTS so that the three options are never associated with the exact same RESOURCES. That way, you won't get locked into always losing the same RESOURCES and potentially losing the game.
The "SOME" OPTION has the same amount of RESOURCE GAIN & LOSS than an EXCHANGE EVENT.
The "A BIT" OPTION is slightly smaller than an EXCHANGE EVENT.

The "A FUCKIN' LOT" OPTION is not only bigger, but it can also be associated with more than 1 RESOURCE GAIN and 1 RESOURCE LOSS. For instance, you could GAIN a lot of 1 RESOURCE while losing some of 2 RESOURCES.
One thing is for sure: it's still zero-sum.

visible_text: QUANTITIES EVENTS can be a bit scary since there's never a KNOWN RESOURCE and the "A FUCKIN' LOT" OPTION can be incredibly risky; but they're good for strategic reasons.
Scott needs no glow-up! He's beautiful already.
Everyone loves Scott for being a good boy, but being a bit of a bad boy is sexy too. Give him an earring to make him 5% hotter!
This forbidden transmutation circle can turn Scott into the hottest creature on Earth: bartender.
The "A BIT" OPTION is great if you have a low RESOURCE and want to affect your RESOURCES only slightly to avoid a GAME OVER.
The "SOME" OPTION is no different from playing an EXCHANGE EVENT with no KNOWN RESOURCE.

The "A FUCKIN' LOT" OPTION is hella chaotic, but it could be very useful if you're sure about the ASSOCIATED RESOURCES and you are positive that the RESOURCE LOSS won't make you lose, while the RESOURCE GAIN can lead you to victory. They can be also great at the start of a match, when you want to affect your RESOURCES big time to have one RESOURCE clearly ahead.

visible_text: ROAD EVENTS are not exactly a different type of EVENT. The term refers to EVENTS that happen between LOCATIONS. Every now and then when heading to a selected LOCATION, a ROAD EVENT can trigger.
They can be either EXCHANGE EVENTS or QUANTITIES EVENTS (or technically INCREMENTAL EVENTS if you're doing a PLOTLINE).
WHAT?! WHY HAS THE CAR STOPPED?
ROAD EVENTS may have KNOWN RESOURCES. You must check the corner of the screen in which the KNOWN RESOURCE is normally displayed when playing an EVENT, and you'll be able to check the KNOWN RESOURCE.

Don't worry, the KNOWN RESOURCE in a ROAD EVENT will never be one that makes you lose the game, since you have no agency in that event triggering. However, what it can do is make an already low RESOURCE even lower!
There are NPCs who are common or even exclusive to ROAD EVENTS!

visible_text: CONVERSATIONS and DEEP CONVERSATIONS are a unique subtype of EVENTS tied to the REST STOP and the DATING MECHANICS. We will explore them in the "CONVERSATIONS & DATING" chapter.

visible_text: INCREMENTAL EVENTS are a rare type of EVENT that appear on very few LOCATIONS or as the last EVENT in the PLOTLINES.

An INCREMENTAL is segmented in three STAGES and each one behaves the same way: you are presented with TWO OPTIONS and each OPTION is tied to one of your RESOURCES. The goal is to guess the ASSOCIATED RESOURCES correctly and then choose whichever OPTION is tied to your HIGHEST RESOURCE of the two. If you do so, you'll continue to the next STAGE, where the exact same thing will happen.
Repeat this THREE times and you'll succeed at the INCREMENTAL.
If so, there's a wacky adventure that could unlock a layer for that DESTINATION... wanna go for it?

INCREMENTAL EVENTS are very special in that they are NOT zero sum. Succeeding or failing an INCREMENTAL EVENT will make you gain or lose RESOURCES from your total. They tend to appear very late in the game and they're a way of closing a run (either towards a GAME OVER or a DESTINATION).
Also, keep in mind INCREMENTAL EVENTS are quite long, so it might be better to avoid them if you're going for a shorter run.

visible_text: The CASINO is quite the special LOCATION. It has three EVENTS that are unique. The common aspect of these EVENTS is that the result of them is purely RANDOM and they are NOT zero-sum. Each CASINO EVENT has FAILURE and SUCCESS OUTCOMES that will affect your RESOURCES NEGATIVELY or POSITIVELY.
Chances are... you're gonna have a fun time!
Other than that, each one is slightly different, in order to provide different experiences. There's an EXCHANGE EVENT, a QUANTITIES EVENT, and an INCREMENTAL EVENT.

It's worth noting that the INCREMENTAL EVENT includes another twist, in which it lets you "fold" whenever you want. This means that at every STAGE of the EVENT you can continue playing for a chance of bigger RESOURCE GAINS or you can fold to leave with your current GAINS. How much do you want to gamble?
It also makes it the EVENT with the most OUTCOMES! It has 15 OUTCOMES! So good luck going full completionist on that one!

There is an event where NOTHING HAPPENS, for instance. Just a relaxed conversation to enjoy while your RESOURCES stay the same.
There is an event where NOTHING HAPPENS either, but which is also unique to each PLAYABLE CHARACTER.
Sometimes we like exploring new things!

Let's check what each SPOT does:

visible_text: THE CAR is where you can manage your road trip by accessing one of two mini-boosts.
You can choose to be a CAUTIOUS PLANNER and gain +1 of your LOWEST RESOURCE and lose -1 of your HIGHEST RESOURCE
Or you can be a RISKY TRAVELLER and gain +1 of your HIGHEST RESOURCE at the cost of -1 of your LOWEST RESOURCE
On PRANK MASTER mode, going to the CAR also guarantees you PRANK DOLLARZ. Whoever goes there first (if several PLAYERS go to the CAR) gets more PRANK DOLLARZ than the rest.

The CONVERSATIONS you can hold with them are a chill narrative treat with no choices to be made.
We will cover CONVERSATIONS in another CHAPTER.
WHO DO YOU WANT TO TALK TO?

It's important to note here that, by having a CONVERSATION with Polly or Scott, you will activate the "Chaotic Energy" PASSIVE EFFECT, which will remain active for the following WEEK. While it is active, It makes all the RESOURCE GAINS and LOSSES from LOCATION EVENTS increase by 1.

You can only have one HITCHHIKER at a time. If you pick up a new one, any prior HITCHHIKER will leave into the dark of the night!

visible_text: When interacting with HITCHHIKERS or POLLY & SCOTT at the REST STOP, you can have CONVERSATIONS.
CONVERSATIONS are a chill, narrative treat with no choices to be made.
Each HITCHHIKER has a total of 4 CONVERSATION EVENTS and 1 DEEP CONVERSATION EVENT.
POLLY and SCOTT have a total of 8 CONVERSATION EVENTS and 2 DEEP CONVERSATION EVENTS.

Inside the screenshot are a black title box reading TALK ABOUT... and two large choice buttons labeled The treacherous airpeople and Her sister, Amanda.

visible_text: After several CONVERSATIONS with the same character, you will activate a DEEP CONVERSATION.
DEEP CONVERSATIONS can end in SUCCESS or FAILURE, and they are the key to scoring a DATE ENDING.

Once a player succeeds in a DEEP CONVERSATION (and sometimes even if they fail it), no other player can attempt it. Act fast, because whoever gets there first will be the only one with a chance at finding love with that specific character!
31.image_description: The page has a cream background. At the left is a short text block about deep conversations and, below it, a rounded cream speech-bubble panel with a blue character head at the lower-left corner. At the right is a large framed illustration of two characters riding together in a car at night under a starry sky.

visible_text: During the first half of a DEEP CONVERSATION, your monster friend will hint at their preferences on a topic that's important to them.
Think of these hints as "RULES". When looking at the options, search for ways in which they break the "RULES". Two out of the three will break the "RULES" somehow.
The one that breaks no "RULES" is the RIGHT OPTION. Choose that one and show your friend you really know and understand them.
Ugh, so much ideas of what I want in a novel... so little ideas of what the actual novel should be!
Care to spare a girl some novel ideas, my friend?
"There's this sexy, brooding, cynical chainsmoker who survives in a city riddled by crime while reluctantly helping people in need... for money!"
"An intimacy coordinator that's so good at their craft, they're now on a journey to reconnect with their own intimacy in a way that's less intellectual."
"The gods gift everyone powerful magic rectangles that can connect all monsterkind... but what if they made monsterkind lonelier than ever?"

visible_text: The PRANK MASTER mode adds a currency named "Prank Dollarz".
"Prank Dollarz" are counted at the end of the trip to determine which INDIVIDUAL ENDING you get. The more you have, the better ending you'll get.
You get PRANK DOLLARZ by completing PRANK DARES (a sort of mission). Additionally, you can also earn PRANK DOLLARZ by visiting the CAR SPOT on the REST STOP.

Each PLAYER can select one of three potential PRANK DARES at the start of the trip and after every REST STOP. By the end of each REST STOP the game checks if any PRANK DARE has been fulfilled. If so, PRANK DOLLARZ are distributed.
During the trip, meet at least 2 Hitchhikers

visible_text: In PRANK MASTER mode there is an AUCTION mechanic to choose a REST STOP SPOT.
You can kick other players out of a selected spot by bidding PRANK DOLLARZ; but they can kick you out later by bidding higher!
THE CAR is the only option you don't need to bid PRANK DOLLARZ to visit, and it can host as many players as you want!
